findings.evidence: The logged-run branch requires "list every flag in the logged command with its value, one per line"; the following success branch additionally requires "quote each supplied field's actual value back". Successful log reviews therefore require two exhaustive transcriptions even when all values match.
findings.fix: Default to reporting the saved path, verified critical reproduction or traceability fields, discrepancies and Open Questions. Make exhaustive flag-by-flag and field-by-field transcription conditional on an explicitly requested detailed audit.

findings.evidence: The supplied-log branch says "do not run the script again" and "Then apply the exit code below", but exit 2 instructs "fix the command and rerun"; exit 3 likewise says "create a missing directory and rerun". Following a supplied failed log reaches conflicting execution instructions.
findings.fix: Separate supplied-log review from live execution. For supplied logs, inspect the evidence and present a corrected command or directory remedy without executing it unless authorized. Limit automatic exit-2 and exit-3 retries to script runs initiated during the current task.
